author: Fritz Matetzschk
text: We purchased our house 5 years ago and needed to pump the septic for routine maintenance. I searched online and found Jimmy’s septic.  He had great reviews and they were spot on.  Jimmy was on time, professional and took care of the job in about an hour.   Price was great and he did a great job.  Highly highly recommend this company. I won’t go anywhere else.

author: Dustin Vance
text: Quick, friendly, good service and very patient even though our second cap was buried and took a little work to find. Highly recommend!

author: Kara Gross
text: I absolutely love the costumer service and how great Jimmy is to work with. While pumping my septic today, he did a great job explaining some issues and how to resolve them. Would highly recommend! Thank you for being the absolute best!

author: Laura Holbrook
text: We simply won’t use anyone else to take care of our septic system. The last time Jimmy came, he told us, given the size of our tank and there were just the two of us, we could wait five years for our next pump out.  We did.  Jimmy came.  He said that there was nothing to pump out and showed my husband.  My husband wanted to pay him for his trip/time.  Jimmy wouldn’t take anything.  That kind of integrity isn’t something you come across often.

author: Rebecca Watson
text: We've used Jimmy's Septic since we moved here 7 years ago and they are hands down along to work with!
